svg.aria-label: Odessia booking loop: a traveller's text request rides a belt into a booking machine. The research drum scans hundreds of options in about a minute; the memory drum remembers preferences learned from years of Gmail booking confirmations; the watch dial re-checks prices daily; the IATA press stamps the booking with its travel-agent accreditation; and only when the lit APPROVE lever is pulled does the booked ticket drop into the out-tray. The numbers are the ones from the story: hundreds of options in about a minute, daily price re-checks, perks at 2,000 hotels, IATA-accredited.
svg.text: hundreds of options in ~1 min · daily re-checks · 2,000 perk hotels · IATA
